encounterTypes.name: Admission
encounterTypes.description: Indicates that the patient has been admitted for inpatient care, and is not expected to leave the hospital unless discharged.

encounterTypes.name: Attachment Upload
encounterTypes.description: Encounters used to record uploads of attachments.

encounterTypes.name: Bed Assignment
encounterTypes.description: Assigning a new bed to a patient without admitting or transferring them

encounterTypes.name: Cancel ADT
encounterTypes.description: An encounter that notes that a request to admit/transfer/discharge a patient is being overridden

encounterTypes.name: Check In
encounterTypes.description: Indicates the patient has done the required paperwork and check-in to begin a visit to the clinic/hospital.

encounterTypes.name: Check Out
encounterTypes.description: The patient is explicitly leaving the hospital/clinic. (Usually no formal encounter is captured for this.)

encounterTypes.name: Discharge
encounterTypes.description: Indicates that a patient's inpatient care at the hospital is ending, and they are expected to leave soon.

encounterTypes.name: Inpatient Note
encounterTypes.description: A short free-text note written by a clinician about an inpatient during their stay

encounterTypes.name: Intra-Hospital Transfer
encounterTypes.description: Indicates that a patient is being transferred into a different department within the hospital. (Transfers out of the hospital should not use this encounter type.)

encounterTypes.name: Transfer
encounterTypes.description: Indicates that a patient is being transferred into a different department within the hospital. (Transfers out of the hospital should not use this encounter type.)

encounterTypes.name: Transfer Request
encounterTypes.description: A stand-alone encounter type for a transfer request not part of a larger note

encounterTypes.name: Visit Note
encounterTypes.description: Encounter where a full or abbreviated examination is done, usually leading to a presumptive or confirmed diagnosis, recorded by the examining clinician.

mappingStatus: No clinical mappings enabled; new-consultation and EMT case definitions require source-form validation.
